purpose: Document Haldwani's official revenue/cadastral entry points and inspect the public map client's service configuration beyond its visible map shell.
assessment: Nainital district and Uttarakhand Board of Revenue route citizens to official Bhulekh land records and the state BhuNaksha application. The public eRegistration GIS is a separate circle-rate and location-services map. Its public JavaScript configuration identifies administrative boundaries, villages, roads and village-union layers; a parcel layer is not identified there. The official land-record and BhuNaksha portals timed out during this review, while direct metadata calls to the configured MapServer hosts failed. These reachability failures do not establish that Haldwani parcel geometry is unavailable.
registryAssessment: Official Nainital district and state Board of Revenue pages identify the state Bhulekh public Record of Rights service and BhuNaksha service. The evidence supports official revenue record custody; it does not verify title status, open parcel geometry, or a citywide parcel layer.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official district/state land-record links and the configured public state registration/rate GIS service family.

officialPrimarySources.operator: District Administration Nainital, Government of Uttarakhand
officialPrimarySources.observation: The district's Bhulekh/Khata-Khatauni page directs users to the Uttarakhand public RoR portal and lists a tehsil-level land-record service center. It is an official land-record route, not evidence of a downloadable geometry API.
The Board's official homepage lists Bhulekh and BhuNaksha as separate revenue applications. This supplies the state-specific BhuNaksha endpoint `https://bhunaksha.uk.gov.in/`.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Department of Land Resources / National Informatics Centre, Government of India
officialPrimarySources.observation: The national Bhu-Naksha product description says the parcel-map management system is intended for authorized state/UT officials and requires a valid user ID to enter. This is documentation of the product's access model, not a test proving that the Uttarakhand public endpoint lacks geometry.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Department of Stamps and Registration, Government of Uttarakhand
officialPrimarySources.observation: The official public GIS map is a location/rate-list client. Its public JavaScript config assigns UK_admin MapServer layers 0-2 and UK_stamp_reg MapServer/2 village, /1 road, /4 village_union; it does not identify a cadastral parcel layer.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Department of Stamps and Registration, Government of Uttarakhand
officialPrimarySources.observation: The Citizen Portal help describes public GIS layer query, village/road search, and circle-rate features. These user-facing functions do not document parcel-boundary downloads or a cadastral feature API.

The official eRegistration MapClient page and its JavaScript configuration were fetched successfully. The JS names UK_admin MapServer and UK_stamp_reg layer paths /1, /2 and /4 for roads, villages and village-union; no parcel-specific layer was identified.

Anonymous HTTPS Get Service metadata requests to the configured UK_admin and UK_stamp_reg ArcGIS MapServer host failed before returning an HTTP response. The failed requests are not evidence of absent layers.

Fresh escalated public-network retries were made to the state Bhulekh and BhuNaksha portals and to both advertised MapServer metadata endpoints over HTTP and HTTPS. Each timed out during TCP connection setup at the provider hostname before returning HTTP; this remains an access limitation and is not evidence of absent geometry.

nextStep: Continue bounded discovery of documented anonymous native parcel-geometry endpoints and inspect their metadata/schema; keep source reachability failures separate from parcel availability.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the Uttarakhand Bhulekh or BhuNaksha endpoints expose anonymous parcel geometry, whether another state parcel service exists, and whether any parcel layer covers Haldwani remain unverified. The public registration GIS configuration does not identify the listed admin/village/road/village-union layers as parcel layers.
